title: Narrow Application-Class Groundwater Head-Accuracy Requirement Qualification

production_context_pin.authority_note: Context only. F-GC06 inherits its research-policy lineage from the exact F-GC05 closeout and does not modify or qualify production source.

application_classes.scope: Agricultural applications in which shallow groundwater regime or groundwater depth drives crop water stress, oxygen stress, capillary supply or yield response at field to regional scale.
application_classes.decision_or_output_quantity: Crop-water or crop-yield response, not groundwater head by itself.
application_classes.required_independent_basis: An externally justified acceptable error for the crop-water or yield quantity plus a source-bound or independently qualified sensitivity that converts that allowance to a groundwater-head allowance.

application_classes.scope: Groundwater-management applications with an externally imposed minimum, maximum or drawdown head threshold at specified control locations and times, where groundwater head itself is a decision variable.
application_classes.decision_or_output_quantity: Head or drawdown relative to an externally defined management or compliance threshold.
application_classes.required_independent_basis: A project, regulatory or decision requirement that states acceptable predictive error or decision margin independently of SWAP-MODFLOW numerical behavior.

application_classes.scope: Applications whose primary reported quantity is cumulative recharge or water-balance flux and for which groundwater head is an internal coupled state rather than the decision output.
application_classes.required_independent_basis: An externally justified recharge or water-balance error allowance plus an independently justified head-to-flux sensitivity or equivalent propagation relation.

research_hierarchy: define the application decision or reported quantity
identify an independent acceptable application error or decision margin
derive H_app only when the application error can defensibly be expressed or propagated as a head allowance
justify A_temporal independently as the fraction allocated to Richards temporal coupling error
derive H_budget only when both H_app and A_temporal are independently defensible
only after policy freeze may a later VQ inspect or test GC02 target behavior
qualification_rule: QUALIFY only an application class for which both an independent H_app basis and an independent A_temporal allocation are traceable and defensible before any GC02 inspection. Otherwise fail that class closed.
hard_nonclaims: no numeric H_app selected at preregistration
no numeric A_temporal selected at preregistration
no numeric H_budget selected at preregistration
no production source, kernel, runtime, solver or coupler changes
